visual.name: plumeDumbbell
visual.description: Dumbbell and dot plot chart with the Plume Studio look: compare two or more values per category (before / after, plan / actual, men / women), sorted by gap, with the gap written in value or percent and colored by direction (favorable / unfavorable, never by color alone); horizontal or vertical; arrows and gradient connectors; images per category or per point (embedded base64 only); min-max range bands; targets; groups by parent category; small multiples; animated play axis.
